# DND Cyprus

> DND Cyprus (legal name: CY-DND HOMES LTD.) is a property developer in North Cyprus. It is the North Cyprus company of DND Homes, a developer founded in Boston, USA, in 2017. Its projects are in İskele and Famagusta (Gazimağusa). Head office: Alasya Park Sitesi 2. Etap, Dükkan No: 2/3, Gazi Mustafa Kemal Bulvarı, Sakarya, Gazimağusa (Famagusta), North Cyprus. Phone: +90 392 444 03 63. Email: info@dndcyprus.com.

The same company appears online as DND Cyprus, CY-DND HOMES LTD. and, for the US parent company, DND Homes. At the PropertyNC Awards 2025, DND Cyprus won Best Newcomer (Gold), Lagoon Verde won Gold and Mariachi Beach Club won Platinum.

## Projects

- [NeoCity](https://www.dndcyprus.com/en/neocity): A new neighbourhood of detached and semi-detached villas with private gardens in the Famagusta region, six minutes from Eastern Mediterranean University (EMU). Prices are in Turkish lira, with a 35% down payment and the remaining 65% paid over 60 months, interest-free and without a bank loan.
- [Lagoon Verde](https://www.dndcyprus.com/en/lagoon-verde): 354 residences around a 3,500 m² lagoon in Ötüken, İskele, from studios and lofts to garden-floor homes and penthouses, with an aqua park, sports areas and a village market. Construction began in October 2026; handover is planned for December 2028. Gold Award, PropertyNC Awards 2025.
- [La Joya Perla](https://www.dndcyprus.com/en/perla): Homes in Bahçeler, İskele, 700 m from the sea, with a sand pool, indoor pool and spa. Under construction.
- [La Joya Perla II](https://www.dndcyprus.com/en/perla-ii): Studios, 1+1 lofts and 2+1 homes with a roof terrace or garden in Bahçeler, İskele. Under construction.
- [La Joya](https://www.dndcyprus.com/en/la-joya): 74 low-rise homes, including lofts and penthouses, in Bahçeler, İskele, 500 m from the sea. Completed in 2025. Holiday stays: La Joya Resort & Residences (https://www.lajoyacyprus.com).
- [Mariachi Beach Club](https://www.dndcyprus.com/en/mariachi): A beach club in Bahçeler, İskele, with a pool, four jacuzzis and pavilions. Opening soon. Platinum Award, PropertyNC Awards 2025.
